## Summary

What problem does this change address, and what does it do?

## Changes

List the important changes and any user-visible effects.

## Verification

- Checks run: include the commands and observed results.
- Checks not run: say why.
- For behavior changes, include concise reproducible offline or synthetic evidence where applicable. Online checks are separate authorized manual acceptance, not a PR check.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Updated user documentation when behavior or usage changed, or noted why no update was needed.
- [ ] Kept credentials, cookies, captured logs/receipts, packages, and generated `target/` output out of the PR.
